name: sapay-ios-shell
description: SApay iOS native shell powered by Capacitor

scripts.cap:sync: npm run copy:web && cap sync ios
scripts.build:ios:simulator: npm run cap:sync && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Release -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
